top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a quantitative, falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model, flat bands at a magic angle) followed by a decisive experiment finding correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, since reproduced by many independent groups in transport and STM and extended to other moire platforms. The citation is kept narrow, claiming the prediction and the discovery of the phases but not the pairing mechanism. Caveats remain (third seat and Andrei's pre-2018 priority, device dependence, lattice relaxation in the continuum model), but the phenomenon is secure. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is a well-verified and cleanly allocated fallback but overlaps with the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes; an award is still preferable to no award.
